title: Every ministry's news, for staff (#11)
question: Staff with the new "See every ministry's news" permission (Church news Publishers to start) get an "All ministries" choice in the admin panel's Church news, and a third tab in the app's News. It lists every ministry's posts that are for everyone, newest first, each naming its ministry. Publishers can put one in church news from its ⋯ menu. Each sketch shows the admin panel (left) and the phone (right). Pick one; the other two go.

options.label: A table to go through
options.thesis: In the admin panel, All ministries shows a table: the post, its ministry, when it was posted and whether it's in church news; choosing a row shows the post beside it. On the phone, the third tab is the usual News page of every ministry's posts, each saying which ministry it's from.
materials: table with Ministry and Church news columns
options.viewport: Church news with All ministries chosen under its own heading in the rail; a table of seven posts; Working bee this Saturday open beside it, its ⋯ showing Put it in church news…; the phone on the All ministries tab.
options.risk: A table is denser than the rest of the desk's lists; the pictures only show once a post is open.

options.label: Rows like the rest of the desk
options.thesis: All ministries lists posts as the desk's other groups do: title, the ministry in accent, who posted it and when, a picture at the right, and a pill when it's in church news or asking to be. The phone's third tab shows the same pills in each post's line.
options.viewport: All ministries chosen; six rows with pictures, two with pills; the chosen post open beside them; the phone's tab with the lead post and rows, two marked.
options.risk: Fewer posts fit on a screen than in a table; with many ministries you scroll to find one.

options.label: Narrow it to one ministry
options.thesis: Like the rows, plus a Ministry group in the rail (with counts) to show one ministry's posts at a time. On the phone, chips under the tabs do the same: Every ministry, then each ministry with posts.
materials: Ministry group in the rail with counts
options.viewport: All ministries chosen, the rail listing ministries under it with Every ministry chosen; rows of posts; the phone's tab with a row of ministry chips above the posts.
options.risk: A long list of ministries in the rail and the chips; more to look past when you only want the newest.
